Connor / Marissa — attaching the artifacts and a short technical attestation for HealthCorp. I also included a network diagram for the EU Private deployment. Attachments (stubs): SOC2-report-2026.pdf, SIG-questionnaire-HealthCorp.xlsx, DPA-with-SCCs-redwood-v1.docx, network-architecture-eu.png

Technical attestation (summary):
1) EU-only processing guarantee
   - For Redwood Private deployments we offer region-locked compute and storage. When a customer selects an EU-only deployment, all customer data (request payloads, generated tokens, model caches, logs, backups) are configured to remain within EU data centers operated in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (depending on customer preference).
   - Cross-region replication is disabled by default. Any replication or cross-region backup is only enabled via explicit customer opt-in and is subject to contractual approval.

2) VPC / network controls and egress
   - Private deployment options: (a) VPC peering with dedicated subnets, (b) PrivateLink-style private endpoints, or (c) on-prem connector for air-gapped environments.
   - Egress controls: customers control outbound rules via their VPC and our edge routing policies. By default, no external telemetry or metrics contain customer data; telemetry is pseudonymized and stored in the region.
   - Fallback behavior: in the event of a regional outage we provide configurable policies: fail closed (reject requests) or fail open to a pinned secondary EU region. We recommend fail-closed for PHI-sensitive workloads; default is fail-closed for Private deployments unless customer configures otherwise.

3) KMS / key management
   - BYOK: supported. Customers can bring keys in KMS providers (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). Redwood supports envelope encryption and never stores customer plain-text keys.
   - Key rotation: supported and maintainable by customer or redwood-managed rotation on a per-customer key ring if requested.

4) Contractual terms / SCCs / DPA
   - We will sign the EU Commission standard contractual clauses (SCCs) in our DPA for Private deployments. Our legal template (attached) includes explicit EU residency commitments and audit clauses.

5) Compliance artifacts
   - SOC2 Type II (report redacted for customer review) — attachment: SOC2-report-2026.pdf
   - SIG questionnaire: completed for Private configuration — attachment: SIG-questionnaire-HealthCorp.xlsx
   - DPA draft with SCCs included — attachment: DPA-with-SCCs-redwood-v1.docx

6) Implementation and timeline
   - Typical lead time: 2–4 weeks to provision a Private EU deployment (depends on network setup and KMS integration).
   - For HealthCorp's RFQ timeline, we can deliver the attestation and artifacts now (attached) and provision a staging Private environment within 10 business days once procurement and order are finalized.

If Legal wants a signed attestation on company letterhead I can prepare a one-page signed statement. Let me know.
